episode.noPreviewNeeded: This file doesn't need a separate preview.
episode.previewRefused: This episode's preview can't be shown. Prepare it again.
episode.stillStopping: The work on this episode is still stopping. Try again in a moment.

file.badLocation: AutoScene can't use that location. Choose a file or folder on this computer or on a network share.
file.badName: That name can't be used for a file.
file.cantShow: That file or folder couldn't be shown.
file.generic: A file couldn't be read or written. Details are in the log.
file.gone: That file or folder isn't there any more.
file.inUse: The file is open in another program. Close it there and try again.
file.missing: A file or folder AutoScene needs isn't there any more.
file.notOurs: AutoScene only shows its own files and folders.
file.permission: AutoScene doesn't have permission to use that file or folder.
file.tooBig: The file is too big for that disk.

internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.

media.toolsMissing: AutoScene's video tools are missing. Reinstall AutoScene.
media.toolsTooOld: AutoScene's video tools are out of date. Reinstall AutoScene.

pack.waitsForFilter: The pack waits for “{{title}}” to check its shots.

plugin.eventRunsItself: An event runs by itself, once it is turned on.
plugin.filterRunsInBuilder: A shot filter checks shots from the scenepack builder.
plugin.hostFailed: Plugins couldn't start. Details are in the log.
plugin.noLogYet: It hasn't run yet, so it has no log.
plugin.notAFilter: That isn't a plugin's shot filter.
plugin.notAPackAction: That isn't a plugin's pack action.
plugin.packActionRunsInBuilder: A pack action saves a scenepack from its builder.
plugin.pageNeedsProject: Open a project to see this page.
plugin.reviewClosed: This review was closed. Open the plugin again.
plugin.reviewExpired: This plugin waited too long to be installed. Open it again.
plugin.saveNameTooLong: That file name is too long. Choose a shorter one.
plugin.saveRunnable: A plugin can't save a program, a script or a shortcut.

project.stillStopping: The work on this project is still stopping. Try again in a moment.

system.logsFailed: The logs folder couldn't be opened.
system.menuKeysFailed: The menu's keys couldn't be changed.

update.gone: That update is no longer available.
